description: Fair-Trade traditional Rope Incense used for puja (prayer) in Nepal. This incense is made using a mix of 8 healing ingredients including juniper, camphor, saldup and asta sugandha. It is then hand rolled into a fine rice paper and twisted into a small bundle. When burned, the earthy scent smells similar to sage. When you walk in the early morning hours in Kathmandu you can see the small mandalas drawn in front of each house where daily offerings are made. Within each mandala is burning this traditional incense. Each bundle contains approximately 50 ropes 4 inches long. To burn rope incense, light the end and place it in a small dish of sand. It will burn to ash. Please burn responsibly  This Ganesh Himal Trading incense was made by a family in Nepal who benefit from the economic stability of Fair Trade. Ganesh Himal Trading Company is a certified Fair-Trade Federation member.
